title: Reviewer stage contract envelope, version 1
description: Every stage child process writes its result as one envelope object to a caller-specified file. The envelope is closed: unknown fields are a contract violation rather than forward compatibility. The payload shape is governed by the registered contract named in 'kind', not by this schema.

envelopeVersion.description: Version of the envelope itself, independent of the payload contract version.

kind.description: Dotted lowercase contract name. The reader states the kind it expects and a mismatch fails closed, so a stage cannot silently consume another stage's artifact.

contractVersion.description: Version of the payload contract. A reader accepts it only if the contract lists it as supported and an explicit adapter is registered for every version below the current one.

form.description: Serialized form the writer committed to. The reader re-checks the bytes against this declaration, so an indented artifact claiming to be compact fails closed.

depth.description: ConvertTo-Json depth the writer used. Recorded explicitly because a host default silently truncates nested structures into type-name strings.

payload.description: The stage result object. Always an object: a bare array or scalar at this position is a collapsed payload and is rejected.
